newsitem.title: MEXICO: Dina up sharply on Q2 earnings.
newsitem.headline: Dina up sharply on Q2 earnings.

text.p: Shares listed by Mexican bus and truck maker Consorcio G Grupo Dina were up sharply at midday trading on the Mexican bourse on Monday.
Dealers and analysts said Dina nominal shares had advanced by 50 centavos to 7.20 pesos on positive market reaction to second quarter earnings the company posted on Friday.

"Overall, we believe that this report confirms that Dina is back on track and should continue to make advances over the remainder of the year," Robert Hulme, an analyst with the Interacciones brokerage, wrote in a research report.
